window_description: BWSC-2025 race week, used as a 2027 surrogate
truth: SILO daily GHI (BoM station-anchored, Queensland Government data drill)
note: Bias = product daily-mean GHI minus SILO daily-mean GHI, averaged over the 7-day window. Positive means the product reads HIGHER than SILO. A window this short is not a long-term climatology, but three independent reanalyses agreeing in direction is still a real signal to watch.

points.aerosol_note: MERRA-2 AOD@550 race-week mean 0.045 (clean air, below 2024 baseline 0.054). Model aerosol-miss ruled out as a cause.
